Algorithm Bank for composable secure algorithms and software insurance

Algobank gives every function in a Python package a content hash (a code Merkle tree) and shows what the package can do: use files, the network, processes or the environment, load native code, or run dynamic code it cannot see into (TOP). Algobanking a package means analyzing it this way.

<script>
// BANK SEARCH: "package" or "package v1.2.3" (also "package 1.2.3", "package==1.2.3"); ?q= in the address works too
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const q = document.getElementById("q"), msg = document.getElementById("msg");
  if (!q) return;                                                    // only the Bank page has a search bar
  const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll("#bank tbody tr")];
  const norm = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_.]+/g, "-");          // PEP 503 package names
  function search() {
    const [name = "", v = ""] = q.value.trim().split(/\s+|==/).filter(Boolean);
    const version = v.replace(/^v/i, "");
    const n = norm(name);
    const named = rows.filter(r => version ? norm(r.dataset.name) === n : norm(r.dataset.name).includes(n));
    const exact = named.filter(r => r.dataset.version === version);
    const shown = version && exact.length ? exact : named;
    rows.forEach(r => r.hidden = !shown.includes(r));
    msg.textContent = !name ? ""
      : version && !exact.length ? `${name} v${version} are not algobanked`
      : !named.length ? `${name} is not algobanked` : "";
    history.replaceState(null, "", name ? "?q=" + encodeURIComponent(q.value.trim()) : location.pathname);
  }
  // EXPORT: the bank as shipped in this page, as bank.jsonl (unchanged) or bank.csv (one column per field)
  const jsonl = document.getElementById("bank.jsonl").textContent.trim() + "\n";
  function csv() {
    const recs = jsonl.trim().split("\n").map(l => JSON.parse(l));
    const flat = r => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).flatMap(([k, v]) =>
      Array.isArray(v) ? [[k, v.join(", ")]] : v && typeof v === "object" ? Object.entries(v).map(([s, x]) => [k + "." + s, x]) : [[k, v]]));
    const rows = recs.map(flat), cols = [...new Set(rows.flatMap(Object.keys))];
    const quote = x => /[",\n]/.test(String(x ?? "")) ? '"' + String(x).replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : String(x ?? "");
    return [cols, ...rows.map(r => cols.map(c => r[c]))].map(r => r.map(quote).join(",")).join("\n") + "\n";
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-export]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const type = b.dataset.export, a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([type === "csv" ? csv() : jsonl], { type: type === "csv" ? "text/csv" : "application/x-ndjson" }));
    a.download = "bank." + type; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }));
  q.value = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("q") || "";
  q.addEventListener("input", search);
  search();
});
</script>
